faq.q: What is an AI ad image generator?
faq.a: It is a tool that turns one product shot into a clean square photo built for social feeds. You add the headline and price in your ad editor.

faq.q: How do I create an image ad from a photo?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, choose a scene and share your idea. The finished square image is ready to download and add to a campaign.

faq.q: Which platforms are the images ready for?
faq.a: The square image suits Facebook and Instagram feeds. Your ad platform controls the final crop for other formats.

faq.q: Can the image include my headline?
faq.a: The scene leaves room for text, but it does not render readable words. Add the headline yourself so it stays correct and easy to change.

faq.q: Can I make several versions at once?
faq.a: You can generate different scenes with the same product and compare them. Add each version to your ad account and test.
Ecommerce brands, performance marketers and growth teams that need fresh feed ads without repeated photoshoots.

faq.q: Can I upload the image straight into a live ad?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Check the crop and safe areas in your ad tool before launch.

faq.q: Do I have to label the image as AI?
faq.a: Disclosure rules vary by platform and region. Follow the guidance shown in your ad tool for each campaign.
